headline: Jakarta Police Deny Reports Regarding Arrest Of Former KPK Chief
seoTitle: Jakarta Police Deny Firli Bahuri Arrest Rumors
metaDescription: The Jakarta Metro Police have formally refuted claims that former KPK Chairman Firli Bahuri was arrested while playing badminton in a recent incident.
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Metro Police officials explicitly denied rumors circulating regarding the arrest of former KPK Chairman Firli Bahuri.
Authorities clarified that investigators were present to coordinate a follow-up appearance rather than to conduct an arrest.
Police stated they expect the former official to remain cooperative regarding the ongoing investigation into alleged extortion.
aiContextParagraph: The Jakarta Metro Police have officially dismissed reports suggesting that former Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) Chairman Firli Bahuri was taken into custody while playing badminton. Speculation regarding an arrest emerged recently, prompting authorities to clarify that officers from the Special Criminal Investigation Directorate were not executing an arrest warrant. Instead, the officials stated their visit was intended to ensure the former chairman attends scheduled legal proceedings related to a case involving alleged extortion against a former Minister of Agriculture. Police representatives emphasized that there is an expectation for the former commission head to cooperate fully with ongoing investigative efforts. The situation remains a subject of public attention as legal processes continue in the capital city, with officials maintaining that procedural steps are being followed to ensure the former official's participation in the investigation.
